scientific_integrity: Exact finite local transfer enumeration is fully specified and supported by a standalone executable certificate; a separately implemented sitewise updater exhaustively checks all configurations through circumference eight. No claim of independent validation or exhaustive assessment of all longer periods is made.
scientific_limitations: Counts only immediate fixed and temporal-two states, plus an explicit longer-period family. The two-row periodic eight-offset multiplicity convention is essential; claims do not apply to a deduplicated simple-neighbor graph. General historical-priority review is not exhaustive, and some closely related full texts were unavailable.
title: Short-return rigidity and traveling triominoes on two-row Life tori
